Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Implement Dispatcher Web UI with scheduling, tracking, proofs, and equipment

- Phase 1: Fix missing deps \(@tabler/icons-react, @mantine/form, @mantine/notifications\),
  add style imports, Notifications provider, new types, fix SchedulingPage field bugs
- Phase 2: Add proof-of-delivery gallery with backend endpoints and filterable card grid
- Phase 3: GPS tracking page with route history playback, speed control, and timeline
- Phase 4: Enhanced scheduling with Table/Kanban toggle, status filters, job detail drawer,
  improved CreateJobModal \(type/priority\) and AssignmentModal \(workload sorting\)
- Phase 5: Equipment management with camera-based barcode scanning, check-in/out,
  localStorage persistence, and activity timeline
- Update README and IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN with Phase 6 documentation

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add user guide and fix WebSocket support in requirements

- Add comprehensive USER_GUIDE.md covering Dispatcher Web UI and Mobile
  Driver App with all features, workflows, and default credentials
- Change uvicorn to uvicorn[standard] to include websockets package,
  fixing WebSocket connection failures in Docker

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
